subject: spanish
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: How do you say “We exchange presents at Christmas”?
questions.explain: “Intercambiar” = to exchange and “regalos” = presents, so “Intercambiamos regalos en Navidad”.

questions.q: What is celebrated at “las Fallas” in Valencia?
options: Huge sculptures are built and then burnt
questions.explain: At “las Fallas” giant papier-mâché figures (“ninots”) are displayed and then burnt in March.

questions.q: How do you say “We should use public transport”?
options: Debemos usar el transporte público ayer
questions.explain: “Deberíamos” = “we should” and “el transporte público” = public transport.

questions.q: How do you say “The journey lasts two hours”?
questions.explain: “Durar” = to last, so “el viaje dura dos horas” = the journey lasts two hours.

questions.q: How do you say “We spent a fortnight in Mexico”?
questions.explain: “Quince días” (fifteen days) is the usual Spanish for “a fortnight”.

questions.q: How do you say 'We must recycle more'?
questions.explain: 'Tenemos que' = 'we must/have to' and 'reciclar más' = 'recycle more'.

questions.q: What does “al extranjero” mean in “viajar al extranjero”?
questions.explain: “El extranjero” means “abroad / foreign country”, so “viajar al extranjero” = “to travel abroad”.

questions.q: What does “El Día de la Hispanidad” celebrate?
questions.explain: “El Día de la Hispanidad” (12 October) celebrates Hispanic heritage and the Spanish-speaking world.

questions.q: What does “los residuos” mean?
questions.explain: “Los residuos” means “waste/rubbish”, e.g. household or industrial waste.

questions.q: What is “la Tomatina” in Buñol famous for?
questions.explain: “La Tomatina” is a festival where people throw tomatoes at each other in a giant food fight.

questions.q: What does “la feria” mean?
questions.explain: “La feria” means “a fair/funfair”, such as the famous Feria de Sevilla.

questions.q: What does “la playa” mean?
questions.explain: “La playa” means “the beach”.

questions.q: How do you say “We light candles and sing songs”?
questions.explain: “Encender velas” = to light candles and “cantar canciones” = to sing songs.

questions.q: What does “el calentamiento global” mean?
questions.explain: “El calentamiento global” means “global warming”.

questions.q: What does “la Nochevieja” mean?
questions.explain: “La Nochevieja” (literally “old night”) means “New Year's Eve”; “la Nochebuena” is Christmas Eve.

questions.q: What is 'La Tomatina', held in Buñol?
options: A festival where people throw tomatoes
questions.explain: 'La Tomatina' is a famous Spanish festival in which participants throw tomatoes at each other.

questions.q: What does “la Semana Santa” mean?
questions.explain: “La Semana Santa” literally “Holy Week” is the Easter celebration with processions.

questions.q: What does “el alojamiento” mean?
questions.explain: “El alojamiento” means “the accommodation” where you stay.

questions.q: What does “sigue todo recto” mean when giving directions?
questions.explain: “Seguir todo recto” means “to go straight on”.

questions.q: What does “los gases de efecto invernadero” mean?
questions.explain: “El efecto invernadero” = the greenhouse effect, so these are “greenhouse gases”.

questions.q: What does “los fuegos artificiales” mean?
questions.explain: “Los fuegos artificiales” means “fireworks”.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'The plane is delayed'?
questions.explain: 'Llevar retraso' means 'to be delayed', so 'El avión lleva retraso' = 'The plane is delayed'.
